guide.title: How to use VisitedCountries?
guide.step.map: Click a country on the map to mark it as visited. Click it again to remove it.
guide.step.list: You can also search for a country in the list and click “Add country” or the plus icon next to its name.
guide.step.date: When adding a country you can set the month and year of your visit. “This year” stats are based on it.
guide.step.settings: Change the theme and language in Settings, and your details and password in your Profile.
guide.contact: Have a question or something doesn't work? Write to us.
